verdict: REJECTED by the frozen key. It fails the strict+adaptive gate at BOTH the doubled cost I imposed for this adaptive round AND the standard 0.00004 adaptive cost every other admitted base was held to, missing the latter by 2.75e-06. The rejection therefore does not depend on the doubling and requires no judgement call about it. The threshold is not relaxed after the fact.

most_important_result_of_the_day.claim: The offline 96-split apparatus predicted this public outcome before the probe.
most_important_result_of_the_day.why_it_matters: This is independent evidence that the offline gate machinery measures real signal rather than public-fitting noise, which is exactly the property a repo review will challenge. It also means the day's many negative verdicts were genuine rejections, not measurement failures.

sign_flip_explained: The 3-column offline audit gave sw28 a weight of -0.053 as a mean-reversion contrast. In the full 29-base ridge it enters at +0.043, because the full pool already contains W45, W60 and W90 and the contrast role is occupied. The mean-reversion reading was right in substance and wrong in parameterisation.
not_adopted_reasoning: The private improvement would be 7.5e-05, which does not change standing. Overriding a preregistered gate after exploring roughly ten axes in one day carries accumulated selection bias, and the defensibility of never having relaxed a frozen threshold is worth more at repo review than 7.5e-05.
branch_closed: No re-parameterisation, no second probe on this signal, per the frozen key.
